warnings: Day 1: May 1 Labour Day — confirm Boulangerie Hincker, La Chaume (or an alternative in Gerardmer), and Le Chalet du Lac are open; many shops closed on this public holiday

Day 1: La Chaume (Summit restaurant near Grand Ballon) is at the summit and physically unreachable at 12:45 from Gerardmer. This lunch slot is scheduled in Gerardmer before the taxi departs (clamped from actual summit timing to 12:45-13:45 to fit the lunch window 11:30-14:00). Use a Gerardmer restaurant or packed picnic instead of La Chaume for this slot
Day 1: Grand Ballon hike finishes at 18:26. With 80-min return taxi, arrival in Gerardmer is 19:46. Dinner at 20:00 is feasible
Day 1: Le Chalet du Lac dinner (20:00-22:00) — dinner window starts at 18:00 so 20:00 is within range but on the later side after a long travel day
Day 1: Boulangerie Hincker breakfast (07:00) overlaps with train departure — intentional: grab pastries at Paris Gare de l'Est before boarding the 07:00 TGV

warnings: Day 2: Sentier des Roches is via ferrata style — DO NOT attempt in wet or rainy conditions. Check weather forecast on May 1 evening
Day 2: Hohneck Summit and Glacial Cirques extension is OPTIONAL — only attempt if Sentier des Roches finishes before 14:00 with sufficient energy. Skip if fatigued
Day 2: Ferme-Auberge du Schiessroth — reserve in advance (+33 3 89 77 61 59), cash-only, confirm open Saturday May 2
Day 2: Total day including Hohneck extension is 13+ hours — ambitious but feasible for fit hikers. Drop Hohneck extension if fatigued

warnings: Day 3: TIMING CRITICAL — Tour des Trois Lacs (4h36) starts 07:48, finishes 12:24. Lunch at Ferme-Auberge du Lac Blanc (12:24-13:24). Taxi to Remiremont departs 13:24, arrives 14:39. Train at 15:30 — buffer is 51 min at Remiremont station. Buy provisions for train at station
Day 3: Ferme-Auberge du Lac Blanc lunch clamped from 14:00 to 12:24 (end of hike) to prevent overlap — the ferme-auberge is on the trail route itself so this timing is realistic

Day 3: Fishing at Trois Lacs (09:45-10:30) is integrated within the Tour des Trois Lacs hike — represents a fishing break at Lac Noir during the circuit. Purchase fishing permit in advance at cartedepeche.fr (~15 EUR)
Day 3: Tour des Trois Lacs and Fishing at Trois Lacs overlap by design (fishing is a break within the hike) — not a scheduling conflict

Day 3: No overnight accommodation on Day 3 (departure day). Studio checkout should be arranged before 07:00 taxi departure. Contact Agnes Marchal (06 86 96 16 04) for early checkout or luggage storage
Day 3: Boutique de la Confiserie Géromoise (06:30-07:00) — the shop opens Mon-Sat but likely not at 06:30. If closed, buy souvenirs at Remiremont station instead
